title: Wild Horse Injury and Expense Reports (Bureau of Land Management Nevada State Office)

communications.subject: Freedom of Information Act Request: Wild Horse Injury and Expense Reports (Bureau of Land Management Nevada State Office)
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

- Veterinary records and mortality records of wild horses or burros, including deaths occurring during capture, transport, holding, treatment, or euthanasia
- Records concerning horse or burro related vehicle crashes, injuries, property damage, fencing damage, water-line damage or other public-safety incidents reported to the state
- Contracts, purchase orders, invoices and payments involving horse or burro capture, transportation, veterinary care, boarding, feed, holding facilities, adoption, or disposal
- Specific cost per horse or burro

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Taylor Moore
